featured_reviews.name: Samta Sardana
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was visiting from Delhi and decided to check out the Wednesday Latin Twist social at Antisocial — and I’m so glad I did! I had an absolutely fantastic time.

Mary led the shines and basic salsa session, and she was incredible. She explained a few things in a way no one ever had before — it really helped things click. The music was superb! I’m not sure who the DJ was, but you could tell he was having a blast, and that energy radiated across the dance floor.

The crowd was just the right size, with dancers of all skill levels — and most importantly, everyone was super beginner-friendly, which made it so easy to relax and enjoy.

By the end of the night, I truly appreciated the vibe and walked away with a big smile and some great memories. I’d love to learn more from Mary if the chance comes up again. Fingers crossed!

If you're ever in Mumbai, this social is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
